The '''sister''' of [[Elscol Loro]] lived with her family in [[Tamarack]], a [[City/Legends|town]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cilpar]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Tamarack was attacked by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Boren Tascl]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].
